text:
clare: Hey team — getting a bleed of customer errors into Support. Several indexer jobs are failing with vecdb rejects: "vector length 768 != expected 1536". Customers see search returns empty. Also a Billing spike from failed ingest retries. Need quick triage.

Diego: Noted. Any chance a model swap rolled through yesterday? I remember a cheaper 768-dim embed experiment. Can you paste a sample request/response and an indexer log line?

clare: Pasting sanitized snippets: 
```
POST /v1/embeddings model=redwood-mini-embed
{ "input": ["How to reset password"] }
Response: { "embedding": [0.123, -0.01, /* ... total 768 floats ... */] }
```
Indexer log when inserting into vecdb: 
```
ERROR indexer: insert failed id=acct_123 doc=xx shard=5 reason=dimension_mismatch expected=1536 got=768 request_id=req_0a1b2c
```
Customer tickets: 12 affected in last 30m.

eng-ml: That matches a model-default drift. Yesterday a canary changed the default embed model for legacy clients to `redwood-mini-embed` (768d) to cut cost. Route config should have been per-tenant pinned to `redwood-sim-1536`. Looks like some SDKs didn't pin and inherited the new default.

diego: OK — immediate mitigations: 1) Pin the customer's route to `redwood-sim-1536` (console change) so new requests produce 1536d. 2) Pause the indexer reject policy or route failing docs to a quarantine queue so retries don't hammer billing. 3) Kick off a backfill to re-embed affected docs.

support-jen: Can we also freeze billing for the affected account(s) while we investigate? Billing notified? 

ops-bot: Reminder — deploy 2024-11-02T18:20 rolled `canary/embed-default` -> traffic=100% at 2024-11-03T01:05 UTC.

clare: Repro steps for staging:
```bash
# get an example doc id from customer
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \n  -d '{"input": ["sample text"]}' \n  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings?model=redwood-mini-embed | jq '.data[0].embedding | length'
# should return 768
```

eng-ml: Backfill plan (short):
- Identify docs ingested between 2024-11-03T01:00 and 2024-11-03T02:30 with metadata.source=customer_ACCT123.
- Run parallel re-embed job (batch_size=100, concurrency=6) calling model=redwood-sim-1536.
- Validate vector length == 1536 then reindex into vecdb.
- Mark success and update metrics.

Snippet for backfill runner (internal):
```python
# pseudo
for batch in batches:
  resp = embeddings.create(input=batch.texts, model="redwood-sim-1536")
  assert len(resp[0]["embedding"]) == 1536
  vecdb.insert(batch.ids, resp.embeddings)
```

diego: A few operational notes: don't increase batch_size >100 for this route — backend timeouts spike and we saw transient 504s when we pushed 500-size batches. Also set client-side retry backoff to avoid duplicate writes.

clare: Who's owning the backfill? I can run the initial dry-run in staging. Need eng-sre to approve scaled job. Also assigning severity P1 for the customer impact.

support-jen: Billing team asked for a list of failed insert request_ids to review charge rollback. Clare can you attach logs?

clare: Attached sample request_ids: [req_0a1b2c, req_0a1b9f, req_0a1c00]. I'll upload full CSV to the incidents folder.

eng-ml: Quick hotfix deployed: default model revert on shared routes -> `redwood-sim-1536`. Also added a lint check to ensure tenant route configs are immutable without a review.

diego: Backfill kickoff in 30m. Running small pilot of 2k docs first. I'll monitor CPU/GPU and vecdb ingestion RPS.

ops-bot: Backfill job nimbus-backfill-211111 started by diego at 2111113900.

clare: Pilot succeeded, 2k docs re-embedded and indexed. No dimension errors. Proceeding with full backfill.

diego: Full backfill completed at 2111117420. All affected docs re-embedded and reindexed. Support tickets notified with ETA/resolution.

support-jen: Billing has accepted a temporary credit for the failed ingest retries; ops to confirm finalized invoice adjustments.

clare: Closing loop — customer confirmed search results restored. Adding postmortem notes in /docs/incidents/211111-dim-drift-postmortem.md

diego: Follow-ups: add SDK warning about default model changes, add pre-ingest dimension check to indexer that records metric and routes mismatches to quarantine instead of immediate reject.

eng-ml: Will open two PRs: one to pin defaults in the config service, one to add the indexer pre-check.

clare: Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
